_provenance: Names only, written 2026-10-21 with docs/prereg_econ.md before any phase-C code and before any held-out number was collected. This file holds NO figures: every value is collected at run time from the named documents, point in time, and recorded in docs/ECON_TEST_RESULTS.md whatever it shows. Expected readings are the preregistered pass conditions, not observations.

h1_identities.pass_rule: status in {consistent, partial with a named residual} for at least 6 of 7 names; each miss recorded by name with its residual, never tuned away

names.core_identity: revenue = customers x revenue per customer

names.core_identity: revenue = bits x ASP (DRAM and NAND bit growth and ASP change)

names.name: Adobe

h2_vendor_financing.pass_rule: each positive control reads at least `elevated` in FY1999 or FY2000 using only documents available before 2001-01-01 (Nortel's FY2000 10-K is filed in 2001 and counts only for FY1999 unless its availability date is before the cutoff); no negative control reads `high`; live cases are reported only

positive_controls.name: Lucent Technologies
documents: 10-K: customer financing commitments note and MD&A liquidity

positive_controls.name: Nortel Networks
documents: 10-K / 40-F: customer financing note and MD&A liquidity

negative_controls.name: Microsoft
negative_controls.kind: no customer financing, no demand collapse

negative_controls.name: Apple Computer
negative_controls.kind: no material customer financing; revenue fell in FY2001 anyway
negative_controls.note: specificity control: a demand fall without vendor financing must NOT be flagged; it shows a low screen is not safety

live_cases_reported_only.name: CoreWeave
documents: 10-K, 10-Q: related-party revenue, customer concentration, vendor financing, take-or-pay

h3_peak_exception_and_process.pass_rule: MU FY2018 and FY2022 read peak_margin_run_rate `high` (memory_cycle is price-cyclical: the exception never applies); PLTR and RDDT filed fixtures read `operating_leverage_or_peak` medium (in-sample, confirmation only); iRobot 2021-2023 process_evidence machine != `working`

cases.name: iRobot
documents: 10-K: revenue by product category / region, R&D expense, advertising expense
